calls.statement:
SELECT 
  SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' 
  AND d.fiscal_week = 22
  AND p.sku = 101624

SELECT DISTINCT 
  sku, 
  product_name
FROM dim_product
WHERE sku = 101624

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  sku, 
  product_name
FROM dim_product
WHERE product_name ILIKE '%Oulu Kaakkuri%'

SELECT 
  sku, 
  product_name,
  listed_from,
  delisted_on,
  valid_from,
  valid_to,
  is_current
FROM dim_product
WHERE sku = 101624
ORDER BY valid_from DESC
